text: minervini: '50-day under the 200-day; RS rank 54.2.' The MA stack is not on my menu, so I do not argue it; I grant it means the long trend is not mine to claim. What I test is the swing: CORRECTION_REENTRY through structure on day_vol 2.03, a higher low bought near the average, the C2 retracement. That makes it a few-session trade (C18), not a trend hold. I hold SUPPORT at 3; I drop it on a daily close under the swing low, or if the re-entry stalls by session 3 (C11).
